stem:
Nitin studies a fern leaf in which each leaflet looks like a smaller copy of the whole leaf. He also looks at a plain rectangle with no smaller copies inside it.

Which claim about the fern leaf is correct?

options.text: It is a fractal, because the same pattern repeats at smaller scales.
It is a fractal, because any leaf counts as a fractal.
It is not a fractal, because only computer drawings can be fractals.
It is not a fractal, because the plain rectangle is the true fractal pattern.

teacher.key_rationale: A fractal shows the same or a similar pattern again at smaller scales. The fern leaf does; the plain rectangle does not.
